product.name: Teeela Toy Shop App
product.description: An application that allows users to choose gifts from a variety of toys, search by age or category, and view video reviews of toys.

product.name: Super-fast delivery
product.description: A service that delivers toys within 4 hours.

product.name: Fun gift wrapping
product.description: A service that wraps gifts in fun, cute animal designs.

product.name: Party props
product.description: A service that provides balloons, confetti, and other party props.

product.name: Video toy reviews and presentations
product.description: A feature that offers video reviews and presentations of toys to help customers make informed choices.

product.name: Customer Service
product.description: A support service available 24/7 via phone and email for customer inquiries and assistance.
